title: Family on Wooden Bridge Railing, 1930s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage sepia snapshot from around 1930 showing four children perched on a bridge railing while an adult man stands behind them holding a toddler wearing a bonnet. The bridge features wooden plank flooring and structural cables or truss supports overhead. Handwritten names are inscribed in ink across the top section of the image: Dorothy, Floyd, Louise Hazelwood, Wilford, Glenn, and Norma. The back is mostly blank with a stamped number 457.
